t: Din mi shennishba shello leekol matztza
s: Din mi shennishba shello leekol matztza ubo g' seipim: mi shennishba shello leekol matztza belel pesach — kopin oto leekol, sheen hashshebua chala lebattel shum mitzva mimmitzvot hattora, shekkebar mushba veomed hu alehem mehar sinay. Uben sheakal belel pesach uben shello akal — hayu malqin oto al shennishba lebattel et hammitzva, dekevan shei epshar lo lebattelah, shehare kebar mushba hu leqayyemah, im ken hare zeh kenishba laasot dabar shei epshar laasotah kelal, shelloqeh mishshum shebuat shov, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman rl"v:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshepperash lel pesach, ben shennishba belayla zeh ben shennishba qodem laken, abal im nishba setam shello yokal matztza velo hizkir lel pesach, mittok shechala shebuato al matztzat hareshut, dehaynu shello yokal matztza qodem layla zeh, veachareha chala gam ken al matztzat mitzva shebbelel zeh, shehashshebua chala lebattel et hammitzva be"sheb veal taaseh", al yede shekkolel immah bashshebua gam debar hareshut. Vekol zeh bishbua (venosach leshon shebua min hattora o middibre soperim — ayyen beyoreh dea siman rl"z). Abal im nadar shello leekol matztza belel pesach, kegon sheamar: "akilat matztzat mitzva alay qonam" — asur leoklo, shehannedarim chalim al debar mitzva, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman rt"v. Umikkol maqom, kopin oto lehattir nidro al yede sheela vacharata, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea sham:

Nishba shello lishtot d' kosot belel pesach, o shello leekol bo maror bizman hazzeh shehu middibre soperim, o shello leekol matztza belel sheni — chala shebuato, shehashshebua chala lebattel mitzvot middibre soperim besheb veal taaseh. Umikkol maqom, rauy lekuppo lehattir shebuato al yede sheela vacharata uleqayyem hammitzva ap im kalal immah bishbua gam debar hareshut:
